name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens dos.library through the exec old-open entry and stores the returned library base in a global variable. Four routines call it.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:00B6
name: fetch_io_error_and_close
description: Fetches the DOS I/O error code, closes the file, closes the library base, and returns a failure status. Two routines call it.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:0130
name: take_over_copper_and_interrupts
description: Forbids task switching, opens graphics.library and saves its copper list pointer, then points it at a new list. It writes interrupt and DMA enable values to the custom chip and closes the library.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:01A6
name: dispatch_copper_and_vblank_irq
description: Interrupt handler that tests the interrupt request register. The copper bit sets a flag to 22 and acknowledges the pending bit; the vertical blank bit restores the saved copper list pointer, calls a routine and increments a counter.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:01D4
name: handle_vblank_counter_tick
description: Checks bit five of the passed flags and, when it is set, restores the saved copper list pointer, calls a routine and increments a counter. One routine calls it and it calls two others.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:0382
name: fill_copper_table_and_delay
description: Writes a repeating pair of 16-bit constants into a table of eight entries, then busy-waits through a nested counting loop. If a flag is set, it also writes two display-control words.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:0492
name: wait_vblank_then_enable_interrupt
description: Polls the interrupt request register until the vertical blank bit is set, then writes the interrupt enable value with that bit set to re-enable it. Three routines call it.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:04B0
name: split_bitplane_pointers_per_quarter
description: Splits a base address into low and high 16-bit words and stores them as four bitplane pointer pairs, spaced 8000 bytes apart, the size of one 320 by 200 bitplane.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:051A

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_or_halt
description: Calls an exec routine that returns an index; if the index is zero it forbids task switching and loops forever. Otherwise it closes the library and jumps through a pointer table indexed by the value, four bytes per entry.

key: strikefleet (1987)(lucasarts)/Strikefleet (1987)(LucasArts).adf:StrikeFleet/sf.prg:0:064A
name: restore_saved_list_pointer
description: Opens a library through exec, stores a saved pointer into one of its fields and into a global, then calls two DOS-base library routines. Only one routine calls it.
